hierarchy.plan_universe: candidates.enumerate_plans v6, limit 16, complete=True required; depends on public snapshot only; identical across replicates, regimes and comparators
hierarchy.estimand_weighting: equal per structure, then per parent within structure, then per twin, then per replicate
hierarchy.twin_population: constructed stress-test population; not a realistic case frequency

population.sizes_are: public snapshots; each receives K replicates per evaluated regime

v1_option.consequence: harm guardrail unattainable (0/8 -> 31.23%); P5b at most exploratory

regime_use.R2: evaluation reading only, reported separately; cannot upgrade an R1 verdict

exclusions.counted_on: all generated candidate parents before filtering
exclusions.replacement: next seed of the committed list, order fixed at commitment

population.abstentions: no recommendation / habitual preferred / invariant failure / refusal evaluated as HABITUAL-1, counted and kept

private_innovations.keying: H(commitment_id, partition, structure_seed, parent_index, replicate, primitive, entity)
private_innovations.commitment: seed-list commitment id 276d965da8a31a5d8ccf536df2841506a004adb8cc461ce3e8c7faf2857df45c, constant over E_k

population.generation_seeds: drawn once per partition, committed by SHA-256 (sorted list + salt) at E0, never redrawn, revealed in final package; disjoint from selection seeds 101-104 and forecast evaluation seeds 901-904

support_constructed.unit: 6-8 beds, IDE only, fixed decision instant 2026-11-16 20:00 Europe/Paris
support_constructed.stays: 2-3 authorised; readiness 08:00 or 11:00; planned departure 12:00 or 16:00
support_constructed.offers: 4 fixed templates (ORA, ORB, ORC, ORD) + inadmissible ORX
support_constructed.coupling: choose_offers reduces admissible offers as coordination sets increase, to keep <= 16 plans
support_constructed.exclusion_rate_meaning: residual of this constructed population only; not overflow of an independently drawn population

reinforcement_truth.v6_policy: conditional; counts selected offers; no presence draw; unchanged
public_fields: pool_key = lending_unit for shared_unit else source

p_pub.not_requested_or_unknown: not generated (erratum: v6 option_admissibility rejects only 'unknown'; 'not_requested' would be admissible as conditional)

realisation.granularity: all-or-nothing per offer over its window, per (structure, parent, twin, regime, replicate)

costs.planned_hours: sum of selected offer hours; OBJ-LEX-1 tier 2 for every tie-break including O_lex

reinforcement_truth.execution_rule: open loop at as_of; absent offer adds 0 staff; no replacement, no replanning, not revealed to planner

eval_adapter.behaviour: removes absent reinforcement actions from the evaluation copy of the chosen plan, then calls v6 TruthProvider / PrivateOracle.outcome unchanged

future_tests_specified_not_run.T-P5-R1: same public snapshot and plan; presence differs for one selected requested offer covering uncovered demand => realised U differs (strictly higher when absent); v6 public recommendation fingerprint identical
future_tests_specified_not_run.T-P5-R2: offer order permuted and option_id renamed => identical presences by offer_key; independent of call order

offer_identity.public_uniqueness: checked per episode when building the sidecar; duplicate = generator defect (stop rule)

comparators.HABITUAL-1: primary reference; simulated habitual practice, not field-validated; no reinforcement in v6 profile
comparators.reference_planner_v6_public: object of P5a; comparator in P5b; unchanged
comparators.U_star_exact_minimum: min over public admissible universe of realised U, per realisation; evaluation only; certified on this universe
comparators.O_lex_business_oracle: OBJ-LEX-1 on realised U (tolerance 15, planned reinforcement hours, interventions); diagnostic only; not a ceiling on U

metrics.primary_unit: uncovered care staff-minutes over 24 h realised under the private truth (OBJ-LEX-1 tier 1, owed admission work included)

P5a_2_descriptive.capture: sum(U_hab - U_plan) / sum(U_hab - U_star), ratio of weighted sums
P5a_2_descriptive.undefined_if: mean headroom E[U_hab - U_star] < 15 staff-minutes per episode (point estimate); then regrets and P5a_1 only

metrics.diagnostic_not_decisional: U_fix = min_a mean_k U(a, w_k); biased downward with K=3

order_1: U_hab - U(r* only): same reinforcements only
U(r* only) - U(a*): coordination at equal reinforcements
resource_decomposition_descriptive.interaction: I = U(c*) + U(r*) - U(a*) - U_hab = [U(r*) - U(a*)] - [U_hab - U(c*)]; I=0 if c* or r* empty; reported with bootstrap CI, no threshold
resource_decomposition_descriptive.attribution_rule: only coordination at equal reinforcements may be presented as value of patient choice

secondary_descriptive: PS-EXP-1 peak and hours above threshold

twins.sigma: circular shift over authorized stays sorted by stay_id hash; step from committed seed stream; never conditioned on truth or outcome
twins.degenerate: fewer than two authorized stays with distinct logistic vectors -> twin_degenerate exclusion
twins.homologous_plans: same (type, target stay_id or offer_key, window) tuple for every action; unmatched plans kept in data, counted, outside precheck

features.identifiers: join only (action->slot, lender margins); never emitted as values nor hashed into features
features.canonical_order: lexicographic on public attribute tuple, then plan-link tuple
features.categories: one-hot over fixed declared vocabulary; out-of-vocabulary = stop
future_tests_specified_not_run: F1 privacy: two truths -> identical vector
F2 renaming: random bijection on all ids -> identical vector and identical choice
F4 distinguishability: different target stays with different relevant attributes -> M_ent vectors differ, M_agg identical
features.claim_limit: empirical representation benefit in this simulator, not exact information loss

twin_precheck.partition: P5b train (24 structures), R1, K=3, before any validation or evaluation generation
twin_precheck.statistic: theta = weighted mean of d_hat^2 - s^2(g)/K, g_k = [U_A,k(a) - U_A,k(hab)] - [U_B,k(a) - U_B,k(hab)]
twin_precheck.informative_if: one-sided 95% lower bound of theta (bootstrap structure then parent) >= 25 staff-minutes^2 (RMS effect difference >= 5)
twin_precheck.descriptive: rate of parents whose best homologous plan differs between twins
twin_precheck.non_informative: P5b stops before validation and evaluation; reported

fit_seeds.expected: identical fits (no documented effect without early stopping, max_features=1.0, < 200000 rows); to verify, not assumed
fit_seeds.others: reproducibility control, never independent replicates in a CI
fit_seeds.if_different: selection criterion averaged over seeds; each seed reported in evaluation
fit_seeds.reported: max absolute prediction difference between seeds

models.choice_rule: argmin prediction over public universe; OBJ-LEX-1 ties (tolerance 15, planned reinforcement hours, interventions)

selection.criterion: structure-weighted mean realised U of chosen plans (R1, mean over K)

E0_initial_commitment: seed lists per partition (hash of sorted list + salt)
freeze_stages.E_k_recommitment: any generator or feature change after E0: new version and hash recorded before corresponding generation; seed lists never redrawn; no choice based on reserved cases
freeze_stages.reading: reserved evaluations generated and read only after F
freeze_stages.single_read_means: no tuning after inspection; reproducible audit replay allowed and recorded
freeze_stages.post_reading: no new reserved test added; any change = new protocol version, already-read results kept

F_b.shared_code_change_after_F_a: versioned E_k, declared; P5a reading stays under F_a

bootstrap.unit_carried: parent with both twins, all replicates, all plans

delta_staff_minutes_per_episode.nature: technical convention equal to OBJ-LEX-1 tolerance; never clinical; change only by explicit amendment

harm.episode_harmed: mean over the K_eval=3 realisations of the read regime of (U_compared - U_hab) > delta; P5b: parent harmed if any twin harmed
harm.structure_harmed: at least one parent (one twin in P5b) harmed
harm.bound: Clopper-Pearson one-sided 95% upper bound on harmed structures / reserved structures
harm.validity: any within-structure dependence; structures i.i.d. by construction; conservative for structure-weighted episode harm rate; non-degenerate at zero
harm.meaning: limited degradation risk, not absence of degradation
harm.consequence: n=30 passes only with 0 harmed structures; n=8 never passes

applies_to.P5b: M_ent vs habitual (M_agg vs habitual descriptive)

precision_projection_before_F.P5a: development variance between structures and parents
precision_projection_before_F.rule: projected CI half-width > delta/2 -> low precision declared before F, verdict capped at exploratory; any enlargement only before F within approved budget
